Pick a club. Every partner links to its source. The open-category list is a
starting point for prospecting research: categories that at least three other
clubs sell a tracked asset to, with the brands that buy them.

```{python}
#| output: asis
print(raw_html(charts.club_profiles("STL") or "<p>No clubs yet.</p>"))
```

Attention numbers are Wikipedia pageviews, a proxy for public attention, not
sponsor value. See [Methods](methods.qmd).
